Package com.javiergs.rtde4j

Class ReconnectingRtdeMonitor

java.lang.Object
com.javiergs.rtde4j.ReconnectingRtdeMonitor
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
public final class ReconnectingRtdeMonitor extends Object implements AutoCloseable
Owns successive RtdeClient connections and restores a read-only joint/TCP-pose monitoring session after I/O failures. No robot commands are sent. Listeners execute on the monitor thread; they must not block. Retry limits apply across failed sessions during one start invocation. A socket read timeout alone does not initiate reconnection.

      public ReconnectingRtdeMonitor(String host, int port, double frequencyHz, int maxRetries, long retryDelayMillis)
      Parameters:
      host - controller hostname or IP address
      port - RTDE TCP port
      frequencyHz - positive read-only output frequency
      maxRetries - number of retries after each failed session; zero disables retries
      retryDelayMillis - delay between retries in milliseconds

      public void start()
